title: aeos.planning.synthesis/1

name.description: Product name (display only; identity is the project UUID)

product_owner.description: Named only if given in the input; otherwise UNKNOWN (never invent stakeholders)

repository.description: Repository reference from the context, or UNKNOWN

issue_tracker.description: GitHub Issues (PERSONAL) / Jira (OFFICE) target, or UNKNOWN

stakeholders.description: Only stakeholders named in the input; mark assumptions

related_work.description: Related work items / RFC / TDD references

decisions.description: Architecture decisions proposed (become ADR/Decision only after human approval)

mermaid.description: Mermaid source (diffable); rendered by the platform, never treated as runtime evidence

verification_source.description: What the diagram must be checked against (contract/manifest/schema/threat model)

residual_risk.description: Residual risk is accepted only by a human RISK_ACCEPTANCE decision

security_privacy.description: 04. Security & Privacy: initial risk/threat notes (no VA/PT results are claimed)

test_strategy.description: Test Strategy is a section of the Test Plan (U-08)

testing.description: 06. Testing (no execution results or sign-off are produced by planning)

release_notes.description: Release Notes are a section of the Release Plan (U-08)

operations.description: 08. Operations (proposals; restore/SLO evidence comes from runtime only)

role_key.description: RoleSkillPack key, e.g. feature-implementer, backend-api-engineer, qa-test-designer

depends_on.description: Task keys within this plan (must form a DAG)

allowed_paths.description: Repository paths/globs this task may write

owner.description: Feature owner only if named in the input; otherwise UNKNOWN

needs_rfc.description: true when an RFC entry with this feature_key is given

needs_tdd.description: true when a TDD entry with this feature_key is given

personal_data.description: Does the feature process personal data? UNKNOWN when not known

threat_model.description: Feature threat model; empty when none

items.description: Per-feature approval artefacts; no findings, approvals or residual-risk acceptance

feature_governance.description: One entry per feature (owner, RFC/TDD/DPIA/assessment needs)

feature_key.description: Feature key, or empty for a plan-level RFC

provider_task_key.description: Task that defines and stabilises the contract

consumer_task_keys.description: Tasks built against it; each must depend on the provider task

contract_paths.description: Repository paths of the contract files, e.g. contracts/api.json

items.description: Contract-first: agreed before parallel work that depends on it (§19, §22)

content.description: DLY AEOS PlanVersion content (Product 1 nodes 00-08 + DAG)

description: Planning Synthesizer output: a NEW plan version plus how each finding was handled
